rule.text:
Yes. For Arvana Pharma, invoices for active pharmaceutical ingredients, excipients and primary packaging must not be paid until the batch shows Released in the QMS [1]. The memo says this applies to excipients without exception [1].

If the batch is in Quarantine or Rejected, raise QA_RELEASE_PENDING. You may post the invoice, but the payment block stays until release [1][2].

citations.quote: Invoices for active pharmaceutical ingredients, excipients and primary packaging material must not be paid until the batch shows status Released in the Quality Management System (QMS).

citations.quote: Pharma invoice for an excipient. L checks QMS: batch in Quarantine. Raises QA_RELEASE_PENDING.

decision: Do not pay until the batch is Released in QMS

older_sources.current_value: Excipients need QA release before payment
older_sources.older_value: Only APIs need release; excipients paid on normal terms

expert_tip.text: The 2023 FAQ still says excipients don't need release. Ignore it: the Pharma memo covers excipients too.
